source_binding.method: Exact source hashes bind the frozen executed working tree before checkpoint publication. Served JS/CSS bytes match both the fresh host production build and actual running image. Historical reports retain their original execution bindings.

runtime.identity_method: docker inspect actual container image plus docker exec sha256sum actual image files and HTTP served asset byte comparison

backend_equivalence.method: Actual running API image file hashes match all60 recorded API-tested backend/dependency/test sources and workspace hashes. This is source equivalence after a UI-only image rebuild, not a new API execution.

methodology: Real Keycloak OIDC/server sessions, PostgreSQL source scans through Temporal/site coordinator/Python worker, real API mutation and canonical read-back. No mocked identity, responses or connectors.
CI dependency ordering uses one worker and zero retries/skips. Automatic traces/video/screenshots are disabled; explicit captures contain authenticated synthetic data only.

Request-budget pacing reads actual rate-limit headers before/after the new journeys, waiting at most 61 seconds within 75-second hooks when needed. Production controls and mutation assertions remain unchanged.
Axe WCAG2A/2AA/2.1AA/2.2AA runs after bounded settling of actually running finite animations, with no rule/element exclusions. Captured viewports assert no document overflow.

Graph captures assert all three loaded node cards fit within the resized canvas, each at least 210px wide, and all node action labels follow English/Arabic locale. Keyboard zoom/fit and the accessible equivalent table remain usable.
verified: Visual/raw immutable relation-type authoring, allowed authored type/descendant and endpoint-state rules, ownership, exact decimal schema, lifecycle and outgoing cardinality/cycle constraints. Export/import round-trip and duplicate-key rejection use the real API.

Real relation creation requires an eligible owner and preserves exact decimal strings, validity instants, provenance and assigned type version. Duplicate, cardinality, cycle and endpoint-state-invalid writes fail without canonical changes.
Stale endpoint versions reject an edit while preserving the draft; current revision reload allows reviewed saving. Valid relation lifecycle transition and immutable history read-back succeed.
Compatible type publication preserves existing relation pins; a changed edge invalidates a prior preview digest, and destructive schema publication is blocked.

Asset relation table and authorized graph support bounded one-row/page traversal. A concurrent mutation invalidates each cursor and clears stale view state; restarting and loading the next graph page preserves the resolved validity instant/fence and merges the exact authorized two-edge/three-node cohort.

Graph layout adapts to 1440/390px using complete measured node geometry, with full-size single-column phone cards. English/Arabic dark/light rendering, keyboard controls and accessible table checks pass.

An actual second PostgreSQL scan after governed edges exist preserves canonical relation attributes, owner, pin, lifecycle, validity, visibility, provenance, assertion version and every immutable revision snapshot; current endpoint versions may advance.
Relation removal records a tombstone and immutable fourth revision/audit event.

Restricted edge visibility removes that bridge and its downstream reachability for a consumer after restart. Denied edge returns 404, restricted history/write permissions return 403, no write ingress is shown, and independent-tenant edge/type/history/graph requests return 404.
All twelve previous real browser journeys pass in the same fourteen-test one-attempt gate.

visual_inspection.method: Implementation agent inspected all 20 final full-gate PNGs with the image viewing tool. This is automated-agent visual review, not independent human sign-off.
observed: Editor, forms, details, version history, table, graph and removal confirmation have readable labels and actions in these captures.
Wide JSON/history/table content scrolls inside its own container without document overflow.
Final desktop and mobile graphs show complete node cards with no observed horizontal page overflow or clipping; Arabic node action labels are present.

root_final_spot_check.method: Independently viewed these five exact final full2 PNGs with image viewing tools; scoped agent observation, not human Arabic or accessibility approval.
root_final_spot_check.observed: Arabic graph actions visibly paint in Arabic on desktop and phone; all three nodes are fully visible and readable at both sizes. Detail/action controls and the editor are readable without observed viewport clipping.

historical_evidence.method: All 75 historical PNGs were copied before execution, fresh regression captures retained privately, and historical bytes restored and verified against original SHA256 values.

diagnostics.observed: First authoring journey failed at the relation-type chooser; root correlated SQLSTATE42601 to a missing closing parenthesis in the inventory predicate. Tenant/permission journey passed. A mobile file-import control class mismatch was also observed.
diagnostics.resolution: Corrected API inventory SQL and added a real HTTP inventory search/pagination/tenant case; the expanded 98-case API gate passed. Reused the existing file-import style and rebuilt.

diagnostics.observed: Authoring timed out while screenshot helper awaited Animation.finished for a non-running timeline. Tenant/permission journey passed. No assertion of a product mutation failure is inferred.
diagnostics.resolution: Poll only actually running finite nonzero-rate animations with a 5-second bound; use 40-second HTTP/download deadlines and safe stage/status diagnostics.

diagnostics.observed: Authoring reached the graph and failed the unchanged axe color-contrast rule on upstream attribution text (#999 on white; 2.84). Tenant/permission journey passed.
diagnostics.resolution: Use the existing secondary-text theme token on the attribution link, preserving the link and all axe rules; rebuild UI.

diagnostics.observed: Both journeys passed, but subsequent actual image inspection found desktop scale/offset retained on the 390px graph, clipping cards. This automated pass is not visual qualification.
diagnostics.resolution: Add one-column narrow layout, bounded fit zoom, measured viewport/node-geometry auto-fit and actual card visibility/readability assertions; retain this passing diagnostic separately.

diagnostics.observed: The new geometry assertion failed at 390px; tenant/permission journey passed. The canvas resized while the graph viewport retained prior dimensions.
diagnostics.resolution: Read-only probes and installed library inspection showed the controlled-node readiness flag prevented the automatic fit. Observe actual measured node geometry and committed viewport dimensions; the corrected targeted and full runs are separate.

diagnostics.observed: Both targeted journeys passed. Subsequent full-gate visual review found the desktop locale paint defect, so this preliminary automated pass did not establish final visual qualification.

All 14 automated journeys passed, but visual inspection found English node actions still painted on the Arabic desktop graph even though DOM text was Arabic. Phone graph and other 19 captures were readable.
diagnostics.resolution: Read-only probes proved the stale paint existed before axe and persisted after two frames and 1.5s. Replacing stateless node content painted the correct Arabic immediately. Product now keys only localized inner node content by locale, preserving graph data/camera. New targeted and full gates are separate.

locale_render_probes.qualification: Read-only diagnostic observations, not acceptance-test executions. Ephemeral DOM replacement was used only to diagnose stale paint; final validation uses the rebuilt product.
locale_render_probes.observed: English→Arabic→English rendered probe verifies actual rebuilt product node actions in both directions and unchanged camera transform, including unchanged axe assertions.

read_only_geometry_probes.qualification: Diagnostic observation only; not acceptance-test executions.
read_only_geometry_probes.observed: Original and first readiness-gated store variant retained desktop transform on resize. Manual Fit proved the current one-column coordinates were correct. Final measured-node guard produced 240px-wide complete cards at both widths, with translated Arabic actions; confirmed again by targeted/full acceptance assertions.

limitations: Scoped browser/development qualification only; no full accessibility audit, independent human Arabic review, vendor-live qualification or release approval.

Positive participation, relation/type joint migrations and their receipts remain future required work. This increment supports minimum-zero constrained asserted relations; derived/imported relation authority and broader lineage are not established.
Arabic translations remain provisional. Screen-reader review, full 200% zoom, all browser/platform combinations and very large graph usability remain open.

Backend storage, hidden-endpoint authorization, resource budgets and transaction concurrency are separately qualified by API/domain/upgrade reports. UI-only rebuilds establish hash equivalence, not a new 98-case execution.

Current graph validity uses the displayed resolved instant; this does not reconstruct historical transaction topology. Bounded complete-query pagination does not claim unbounded traversal or total inventory snapshots.
